hooks.name: Session wrap-up (manual)
hooks.description: Run manually at the end of a work session. Replaces the old Stop hook, which fired after every agent turn and burned tokens.

action.prompt: Wrap up the session in 8 lines or fewer: (1) one-line summary of the work; (2) the spec status line from approvals.md and tasks.md; (3) any new durable facts written to .kiro/memory/ (no duplicates; set 'Last updated' in 04-project-memory.md); (4) git commands for the user to run manually, if there are changes; (5) pending deploy steps, if any. Do not commit, push, or deploy.
